cluster_recommendation: The three-way ontology split (ontology-core authors/exports, ontology-enrich validates/regenerates, ontology-augment consumes at inference time) is the right shape and should stay three skills, not merge — but two structural defects need fixing before the split is trustworthy: (1) both ontology-core and ontology-enrich document a TTL-generation workflow that shells to Ontology-Tools/tools/converters/convert-to-turtle.py, a Python path that does not exist anywhere in this checkout — the Rust ontology-tools crate that replaced the Python originals (confirmed on PATH, confirmed via its own source) never implemented TTL export, so the estate's actual Turtle-generation story is currently broken in both skills' docs and needs either a real `ontology-tools export-ttl` subcommand or corrected references; while there, ontology-enrich's raw `sed -i` field edits should be replaced with ontology-core's own safe `ontology-tools modify --set` path. (2) ontology-augment — the one always-loaded, load-bearing member of the trio — has a frontmatter name that doesn't match its directory and a tool-surface table (repeated in REFERENCE.md) that documents unprefixed tool names (`search`, `class_get`, `graph_query`) which don't match the live registered ontology-bridge MCP server's actual tool names (ontology_search, ontology_class_get, ontology_graph_query, plus four undocumented tools); both are concrete, fixable defects, not just estate-wide vocabulary drift. The podcast pair is a legitimate, well-evidenced one-off-backfill-vs-weekly-cron split — all three Rust binaries (podcast-ingest, podcast-promote, podcast-bulk-ingest) and every cited module/config path were verified to exist and match agentbox.toml's [vault]/[skills.podcast_ingest] ground truth, and even the external OntoCast bootstrap dependency in podcast-bulk-ingest checks out against a real sibling checkout — so the 0.50 Jaccard score is shared vocabulary, not genuine overlap; the real problems are that both skills are invisible to SKILL-DIRECTORY.md and routing-table.md, and podcast-knowledge-ingest's tree has accumulated 349 files of live pipeline output, test fixtures and a 766KB self-declared-historical runbook that all bake into the shipped image and belong in references/ or an external data store instead. echoloop is a legitimately self-contained vendored tool — confirmed to have no dependency on the container's voice/tab0-bridge/Unmute plane, correctly excluded from registered-skills.txt, and correctly listed in both discovery docs — its only real defect is a hardcoded stale gpt-4o default model.
